note: HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421) worked examples, vendored as the rfc-editor.org plain-text rendering of the RFC itself. The harness extracts the Appendix B.1.4 Ed25519 test key and the Appendix B.2.6 signed-request example at runtime, verifies the example signature with node:crypto as a reference control, then runs art-129's verifier over the same data.
